name: c-attachment-1
title: Single file attachment in an assistant reply
label: Assistant Reply
description: Single file attachment in an assistant reply

guidance.bestFor: A full width report card under a reply paragraph, with type and size and a secondary download button
agentNotes: The download `AttachmentAction` has no handler yet, so wire it to the file it names

whenNotToUse.when: Files the user still has to pick from their own device
A file still in flight or failed that needs a retry or cancel

guidance.bestFor: A chat textarea topped by xs chips that scroll sideways, a paperclip that adds files and a live attached count
agentNotes: The paperclip appends the next entry of `FILES` rather than opening a file dialog; wire a real picker as in `c-attachment-6`
The `form` `onSubmit` only calls `preventDefault`, so Send posts nothing until you add your handler

whenNotToUse.when: Picked files from the system dialog, checked against count, size and type limits

name: c-attachment-3
title: Image thumbnails in a snapping strip
label: Image Strip
description: Image thumbnails in a snapping strip

guidance.bestFor: Vertical image cards whose full card button marks one as pressed and prints its name and dimensions below
agentNotes: `SHOTS` loads Unsplash images at 120px and 2x density; point each `src` at your own thumbnails
A pick only sets `selectedId` for the caption; open your own preview from the `AttachmentTrigger` `onClick`

whenNotToUse.when: Image picking by drag and drop from the desktop, with size checks

name: c-attachment-4
title: Three sizes carrying three levels of an answer
label: Three Sizes
description: Three sizes carrying three levels of an answer

guidance.bestFor: Default, sm and xs cards stacked under text labels to rank a deliverable, its working files and cited snippets
agentNotes: Keep `tabIndex` on the xs `AttachmentGroup` while its chips hold no buttons, or keyboard users cannot scroll it

whenNotToUse.when: A single returned report that the reader downloads from the card

name: c-attachment-5
title: Upload queue across all five states
label: Upload Queue
description: Upload queue across all five states

guidance.bestFor: Each of the 5 states on its own row, with a spinner while uploading, a retry on the failure and cancel or remove labels by state
agentNotes: `retry` flips the row straight to done with a fixed 640 KB size; call your upload again there
`dismiss` only drops the row from local state, so abort the in flight transfer there as well

whenNotToUse.when: Transfers that need a bar filling toward 100 percent on each row
Rows led by a colored badge naming each format, such as PDF or MP4

name: c-attachment-6
title: File picker that fills an attachment tray
label: File Picker
description: File picker that fills an attachment tray

guidance.bestFor: A dashed idle card that opens the system dialog, then lists picks as sm rows with image previews, sizes and limit errors
agentNotes: Nothing sends the picked `files`; hand them to your upload code and move each row off `state` idle as it goes
The limits are the `maxFiles`, `maxSize` and `accept` options of `useFileUpload`; the `AttachmentDescription` text repeats size and type, so edit both

whenNotToUse.when: Picking by dragging files from the desktop onto a drop zone
Files already uploading or failed that need a retry and cancel
